label: Before workout
subtitle: Gentle preparation · approved Flex breathing video + Marcus

items.name: Calm seated breathing
items.note: Approved C09-R2: seated Flex breathing with white left cast supported. Follow Marcus English instructions once; the visible breathing animation continues while the preparation timer runs.

items.name: Easy hand openings
items.note: With forearms supported if needed, gently open and close your hands. No weights; stay within your clinician's restrictions.

items.name: Controlled arm reaches
items.note: While seated and only if cleared, gently reach your empty hands forward, then return within a comfortable range. Keep the injured left leg fully supported. Follow the demonstrated controlled movement.

label: Approved Flex workout
subtitle: Five locked demonstrations · original Flex and Marcus

items.name: Seated dumbbell shrugs
items.note: Approved original black-tank-top shrug video with the white left cast. Lift shoulders under control; keep cast supported.

items.name: Seated hammer curls
items.note: Approved hammer curls. Palms face inward and elbows stay near the torso.

items.name: Seated front raises
items.note: Approved front raises. Raise arms forward, then lower smoothly.

items.name: Alternating seated dumbbell curls
items.note: Approved alternating curls. Right leg down in shoe; left cast elevated.

items.name: Seated INNSTAR chest press
items.note: Approved forward chest press, using black handles with the INNSTAR center pad hidden between back and chair. No dumbbells in the chest-press demonstration.

label: After workout
subtitle: Gentle recovery · approved Flex cooldown video + Marcus

items.name: Return to steady breathing
items.note: Approved C10-R1: seated Flex cooldown breathing with the white left cast supported. Marcus guides you to settle your breathing, while the approved moving animation continues.

items.name: Relax shoulders and hands
items.note: Gently release shoulder and hand tension within comfortable limits. Avoid pulling on the injured leg or moving the cast.
